'''Squad Besh''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] deployed to [[Yetnis]] during [[Operation: Rebel Hunt]]. They were trained in operating in [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] terrain. It was made up of eight [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who reported to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ril Garn]].<ref name="H&S" />
